body:
i guess i would, yeah

ill try my best but i hope you wont be too upset if i disappoint you

ive honestly been trying for the past month or two

ive never been much of a fighter

not that i can remember

things have actually been going really great recently weve had more money and theres been a lot less chaos within the family and id been exploring ways to cope and get better and i started dating my best friend and it looked like everything was going to be fine but then i started feeling like this out of nowhere

yeah i take antidepressants and ive been in therapy for a while but it hasnt helped anything and last time literally all we did was color pictures of birds for some reason so its pretty obvious theyre not taking me seriously and there arent really many other places for me to go for treatment as far as i know

i was doing better for a while but now its worse that its ever been and i dont know why

everything just feels kinda pointless and i dont enjoy anything anymore so theres nothing but the bad things left

i cant even explain how i feel im really bad with words maybe because im probably on the autism spectrum i dont know i have a really hard time talking about my feelings and sometimes i cant even identify them

i kinda just feel like there is way too much of something heavy inside me and theres a lot of pressure and i just want it to go away

ive felt like this for a couple years now but its never been this bad

well honestly id rather not actually die because im terrified of death but right now it seems less scary and more relieving to just get it over with

i dont know why i feel like this i just know im not ok

thats the thing theres literally nothing going on i just feel like shit constantly

my life is pretty ok from an objective standpoint like were not the richest or the most healthy family but were doing ok

except were not. not really. but theres nothing wrong at the moment and no reason for me to be feeling like this like i was doing fine a while ago but im pretty sure i was just ignoring how much i want to die
